  "required_fixes": [
    "R1 (high) — crates/desktop-core/src/authority/offline_domain.rs:480,531,610: cached desktop.attempt.get replies are returned unchanged without checking their own lease, course access or pinned-revision withdrawal. Revalidation checks downloaded courses only. Academy's actual getAttempt contract supplies a lease and removes authored definitions when access is revoked or the pinned revision is withdrawn (.inputs/academy/src/server/services/desktop/attempts.ts:311). Consequently a previously unlocked cached attempt can keep exposing its authored lab definition indefinitely, including after expiry or course withdrawal. Enforce the cached attempt's account/lease/revision authority and revalidate it on reconnect while preserving the learner's own work. Acceptance: real-shaped cached attempts expire, lock after course revocation and after pinned-revision withdrawal with course access still allowed, survive restart in that locked state, and retain legitimate local drafts; no automatic submission or grading occurs.",
    "R2 (high) — crates/desktop-core/src/authority/offline_domain.rs:349; authority/learner_domain.rs:1266; authority.rs:1999: offline key creation and blocking filesystem work do not participate in the reset write ledger. Reset waits for writes_in_flight and learner_writes only; ensure_open can subsequently put its key and recreate the root, and local OfflineJob work continues without a retirement check. An admitted worker paused between key lookup and creation, or queued on the blocking pool, can therefore write after reset reports completion. Coordinate offline opening/writes with retirement and reset, including already spawned blocking work. Acceptance: hold the first offline-key write and local save/open at controlled barriers, request reset, release them, and prove reset completes with no surviving/recreated key, root or record, including after restart.",
    "R3 (high) — .inputs/academy/src/features/labs/desktop/use-desktop-draft.ts:141,220: local persistence occurs only after a remote save fails and saves the work captured when that request began. A later edit remains only in React; unmount cancels its autosave timer. Independently reproduced with the production hook: send A, edit B while A is pending, leave the lab, then fail A; the device receives A and reopening restores A, losing B. Preserve the latest unconfirmed work across navigation/close independently of an older remote request's completion. Acceptance: delayed/offline saves with edits made during the request recover the latest edit after leaving and reopening/restarting; stale completions cannot overwrite it and recovery does not send it automatically.",
    "R4 (medium) — .inputs/academy/src/features/labs/desktop/use-desktop-draft.ts:98,105: a delayed local load can complete after a newer remote save succeeded. forgetLocal sees kept=false and skips clearing; the delayed load then sets kept=true and returns because fresh=false. Independently reproduced: Academy confirms new work at version 1, the old device copy remains uncleared, and reopening restores that obsolete copy at version 0 over the newer confirmed work. Coordinate local loading, confirmation and clearing so a late read cannot resurrect an obsolete copy; do not treat an unconfirmed clear as completed. Acceptance: release the local read after save/conflict confirmation and verify subsequent reopen retains the confirmed work, with delayed/failed clears and newer local edits handled without loss.",
    "R5 (high) — crates/desktop-core/src/offline.rs:355,369,415: the instance file lock does not serialize threads sharing an Arc<OfflineStore>. Concurrent puts use the same .<record>.tmp, remove one another's temporary files, and check quota before either commits. Revalidation and downloads can write the same course concurrently; one writer can rename the other's incomplete file, and different-record writers can exceed the account cap. Serialize quota reservation and commits/deletions, use safe temporary-file ownership, and prevent stale read-modify-write revalidation from overwriting a newer download/removal. Also account for preserved .unreadable files: usage currently excludes them, allowing retained storage to grow beyond the stated policy. Acceptance: barrier-driven overlapping writes/readers and revalidation-versus-update/remove preserve complete authenticated records, never acknowledge another writer's bytes, respect account limits, and preserve recovery files within an explicit bounded retention policy.",
    "R6 (medium) — crates/desktop-core/src/authority/offline_domain.rs:727: assemble retains every unit/lab response before checking the 16 MiB record limit in store.put. MAX_UNITS=400 is only a count bound: valid Academy parts below its 7 MiB cap can accumulate gigabytes, followed by additional cloning/serialization, for a download that must ultimately be rejected. Enforce an aggregate byte/allocation budget while assembling and stop fetching once the course cannot fit. Acceptance: many individually valid bounded parts are rejected promptly at the aggregate limit without retaining/fetching the remainder, with existing downloads unchanged and the workload's memory bound demonstrated."
  ],
  "blockers": [],

  ],

    "Downloads shows only a count of local drafts and says to open their labs. Consider listing recognizable lab/course labels and direct reopening actions so learners can find saved work without remembering its location."
  ],
